scientific_integrity: Proof plus standalone exact and numerical verification; no computational check is presented as proof of an infinite limit.
scientific_limitations: Fixed strictly interior transition probabilities and run fraction only. The exact finite conditional run-law is known from classical literature and is not a novel claim. Early 2004 paper on joint runs was accessible only as an abstract, leaving a material implicit-coverage risk. No independent scientific audit has been performed.
title: A sharp parity-adjacent run conditioning distance for stationary binary Markov chains
